note: unhingedthemes keeps ONLY the latest zip upstream, so the clean base of the version we ship is committed at base_zip_local (immune to upstream deleting older versions). upstream_zip_url is used by the watcher/adopt to fetch newer versions.
changelog:
2.2.22 - Persistent SDR-only display. The window's one-off 'SDR only' filter now re-applies itself for as long as the ENGINE'S OWN pair of filters is set to Exclude (filter.hdr + filter.dv), so a viewer whose TV cannot show HDR stops re-picking it on every single search -- the wizard asks once at install and the toggle lives in Wizard > Maintenance. Ours runs on top of upstream's own pass purely for COVERAGE: that pass matches the [B]HDR[/B] and [B]D/VISION[/B] badges only, so it misses [B]HDR10+[/B], HLG and every release whose HDR is in the name alone. It never empties the window (an all-HDR result set is shown in full) and it stays out of an explicit filterless search. Verified against the 3,240-name corpus and mutation-tested. The sources window also carries the switch itself: one row in the filter menu that reports the state and flips it -- once the filter is on the engine drops HDR/DV BEFORE the window is built, so nothing on screen said the list was filtered and there was no way back without leaving the window. Turning it on there narrows the open list for real (same never-empty guard); turning it off says a new search shows everything, because the rows the engine dropped are gone before the window existed.

2.2.21 - Re-merged onto Gears 2.4.2. Upstream added MDBList: a 4th watched_indicators option, mdblist.api_key/mdblist.user settings, the MDBList watched_title branch in movies/tvshows, and an "MDBList Lists" navigator item gated on mdblist_user_active(). All five overlaid files merged with ZERO conflicts; our 10 hebrew_subtitles settings and the KODIRDIL marker counts (8/3/1/3/1) are unchanged. Upstream also ships __pycache__ dirs in the zip -- already covered by EXCLUDE_DIRS.

2.2.20 - Quality labels: the resolution list learned 8K/4320p, 1440p/2K/QHD and the WIDTHxHEIGHT forms, and now tests the highest tier FIRST -- upstream checked 720 before 1080 before 4K, so a name carrying more than one marker was labelled by the lowest tier it mentioned. Kept identical to POV's table.

2.2.19: reverted the status-first rewording (Asaf preferred the previous "נמצאו N כתוביות" phrasing) and instead made the WHOLE subtitle line bold -- every branch: the found-count, the embedded note, the "0 מעל N%" case, "אין כתוביות", and the "התאמות" label. Verified no nested [B] tags are emitted (the embedded note is interpolated into an already-bold string, so it carries no bold of its own). POV keeps the single-label layout with our own [CR] line; the skin overlay is now just two edits vs clean upstream (label height 40 -> 62 and the extra $INFO). 2.2.18: the Hebrew subtitle line now ANSWERS THE QUESTION first. It used to open with a neutral count ("נמצאו 5 כתוביות") in the same size and weight as POV stats, so the one thing a Hebrew speaker needs -- is there a subtitle or not -- was buried (Asaf 2026-08-13). Now the status leads, bold and colour-coded: green "יש כתוביות" when something actually matched, amber "כתוביות ללא התאמה" when subtitles exist but none reached the sync threshold (with the count as grey detail), red "אין כתוביות" when there are none. POV also gets its OWN skin label at font13 vs the stats' font10, so it is visibly bigger rather than just another coloured line. 2.2.17: the panel is now a LEGEND for the list. Per-quality figures take their colour from the same info_highlights_dict the row badges use (passed in from the window), so they follow the user's own POV colour settings -- on Asaf's box magenta/cyan/mediumorchid/dodgerblue -- instead of a hardcoded set that would drift the moment he changes one. Falls back to the previous fixed colours if no map is passed. The figures and the subtitle count are BOLD so the data stands out from the labels. 2.2.16: panel colours now echo the ROW colours instead of using orange for two different things (Asaf 2026-08-13: "למה נמצאו X כתוביות בכתום וגם התאמות בכתום"). One colour, one meaning, in BOTH places: deepskyblue = subtitles (the row label "כתוביות:"), cyan = embedded, orange FFFF8800 = a match (the row's "77% התאמה"). The panel had used a second, near-identical orange (FFFE9900) for the found-count, so the two concepts were indistinguishable. Per-quality figures keep their own colours. 2.2.15: each quality token in the subtitle panel is prefixed with LRM (U+200E). The leading DIGIT of "4K:3" was being absorbed into the neighbouring Hebrew run, so the panel rendered "התאמות 4" on one side and an orphaned "K:3 1080p:2" on the other (Asaf 2026-08-13). Same technique the Gears debrid banner already uses (RLM), so directional marks are known to render correctly in this build. 2.2.14: top panel bidi + width fixed. The skin label renders "<total_results> Results", so appending our Hebrew put it in the MIDDLE of an English sentence -- it rendered scrambled and overflowed into "..." (Asaf 2026-08-13). Our text now leads, leaving ONE direction switch and a single Latin run at the end ("... 4K:3 1080p:3 | 30 RESULTS"). The per-quality run was also compacted (no spaces around separators) so the line fits: 54 chars vs ~70. 2.2.13: top panel now labels the per-quality figures "התאמות:" -- they count SOURCES that matched a subtitle, not subtitles, and sitting unlabelled next to "נמצאה כתובית" they read as if 8 subtitles were found when ONE subtitle matched 8 releases (verified against the log: 8 matches, 8 distinct names, 4K:5/1080p:2/720p:1 -- the figures were already correct). 2.2.12: subtitle headline count fixed -- total_subtitles_found_count already includes the embedded matches, so adding the embedded count again inflated it (1 external + 1 embedded was shown as "נמצאו 3 כתוביות (1 מוטמעות)" instead of 2). Asaf spotted the wrong numbers in the top panel 2026-08-13. 2.2.11: re-merged onto clean Gears 2.4.0 (Simkl integration: auth, sync service, calendar, watched-indicator source #2; navigator menu props now cleared at service start so icon/name edits apply without a manual Restore Menu; resume-point handling moved into watched_status.apply_resume_to_listitem). TRAP: upstream converted the whole addon from CRLF to LF, so a naive 3-way merge reported 12 conflicts across ~8600 'changed' lines -- all phantom. Normalising ours/base/new to LF first dropped it to ZERO conflicts and a real surface of 8-150 lines per file; our overlay files are now LF too, so the next re-merge is clean. All 6 overlaid files verified: KODIRDIL markers intact (8/3/1/3/2/1), 10 hebrew_subtitles settings present, TorBox days-remaining banner intact, Simkl features fully adopted, 0 upstream lines lost (every apparent loss confirmed as our own baked default: max_threads 100, omdb key, cached-only external check, results.timeout 12, no auto-rescrape, autoscrape_next_episode). Also: upstream shipped _tmp_tango.py, a maintainer's personal sqlite debug script with hardcoded %APPDATA% paths -- excluded from the mirror and the shipped zip (the committed base zip keeps it, staying byte-identical to clean upstream for future merges). Hebrew subtitles overlay (kodirdil) + baked build defaults (cached-only fast search, non-blocking Hebrew match, meta_language he). 2.2.10: official TMDb network logos for the streaming-networks folder (11 icons).
